trap.label: conectivo e vírgula
trap.wrong: Nevertheless he continued, furthermore he won.
trap.right: Nevertheless, he continued; furthermore, he won.
trap.why: No português ligamos orações só com vírgula ou sem pontuação. Em inglês, conectivos como nevertheless e furthermore pedem ponto/ponto e vírgula antes e vírgula depois.

mcq.why: be bound to = com certeza vai.
Lembrar de fazer algo: remember to + base.

fix.wrong: It rained. Nevertheless we went out.
fix.right: It rained. Nevertheless, we went out.

fix.wrong: I remember to see her last year.
fix.right: I remember seeing her last year.
Firms are bound to adopt it.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com Consequently: “The pilot failed, so they stopped.”
rewrite.answer: The pilot failed. Consequently, they stopped.
